description: WRSS is an R water-resources-system simulator representing reservoirs, aquifers, rivers, diversions and demand sites. It supports operating-policy simulation and allocation or hydropower analyses. The metadata is published or maintained by CRAN package authors. It describes a generic modelling method or tool. Its domain, time horizon and numerical resolution depend on the configuration; worldwide validation is not established. The provider page supplies a documented method or software entry point; package availability and execution requirements were not independently tested. Licence: GPL-3 (CRAN label). CRAN provides the package under its stated GPL-3 licence without payment. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims.
